summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The m+ DynaBuffer ETF (MPDB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund is an actively managed fund that seeks levered upside, up to a cap, while reducing downside risk, to the SPY ETF. It employs swaps to gain exposure to a laddered buffer index comprised of buffer notes consisting of put and call options referencing SPY. MPDB was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by m+ Funds.
